title: 全套题库修订与审计 · 2026-09-27
scope: All serialized question instances, stable IDs, multilingual options/explanations, identical-content key consistency, source resolution and independent-test selection. This does not certify every natural-language answer or every curriculum standard.

sources.title: Praktis Topikal KSSR (2023) Bahasa Melayu Tahun 1 — published corrected exercise page
sources.pages: PDF pages 1–2; printed exercise page 16, Tema 3; author Alfian Mansor; code TPC161013
sources.observed: The correction changes the grammatical category in both the note and the instruction. The visible exercise connects familiar actions with pictured objects and labels LS 5.1.2(i).
sources.usedFor: Keep grammar terminology aligned with the actual decision and make the communicative context explicit. The original P1 introduction prompt and P3 subject explanation use this editorial principle; the latter is checked separately against DBP.
sources.limits: One corrected exercise page, not the complete workbook. Does not independently establish P2 or P3 curriculum coverage. No exercise copied.

sources.title: Pentaksiran Bilik Darjah (2025) Bahasa Inggeris Tahun 2B — published corrected sample pages
sources.pages: PDF pages 3–9; printed pages 9, 14, 29, 30, 32, A-2 and A-4; author Yu En
sources.observed: Speaking uses short requests and matching replies. A short reading passage tests literal details and capabilities. The assessment pages contain brief messages and a trip notice with eligibility, materials and registration information; visible answer pages accompany them.
sources.usedFor: Reference for concrete primary-language load and distractors linked to a stated detail. Our P1 grammar sentences and two-condition notice candidate matrices are original; the source illustrates the approach rather than supplying their content.
sources.limits: Selected public correction pages only. A Year 2 sample is a nearby language-load reference, not proof that every selected word is a prescribed Year 1 word. Source tasks have their own format; we did not copy them.

sources.title: UASA Bahasa Melayu SJKC Tahun 4, 5 dan 6 — Set 3 public sample
sources.pages: 42-page public PDF; inspected PDF pages 1–5 and the notice questions on pages 28–29; first paper explicitly labelled Tahun 4
sources.observed: The visible pages combine contextual grammar, passage questions and multiple source materials. Notice information must be distinguished from neighbouring facts; options test different factual claims.
sources.usedFor: Original notice questions now require checking both conditions and distinguish four plausible combinations. General reference for upper-primary information-reading task structure; secondary age changes are editorial context choices.
sources.limits: Year not printed in the inspected pages. Did not read or certify every item in the 42-page sample. This primary sample does not establish secondary grade progression.

sources.title: Praktis Topikal Bahasa Cina Tahun 2 — published corrected exercise page
sources.pages: PDF pages 1–2; printed page 60, Unit 20; author 玉禾; code TPC162073
sources.observed: The visible language note distinguishes homophones by character and meaning. The following task ties word formation to specified characters.
sources.usedFor: Explicitly identify the target character occurrence in repeated-character pinyin tasks and give lexical choices a visible context. The pinyin ambiguity rule itself is supported by the MOE dictionary guide.
sources.limits: A homophone/word-formation page, not a source for all tone values or Malaysian tone conventions. No exercises copied.

sources.title: Praktis Topikal UASA (2026) Bahasa Cina Tahun 4 — published corrections and answer pages
sources.pages: PDF pages 1–4; printed answer pages J-1 and J-4; author Tan Huey Ying; code TACPCL2604056T
sources.observed: Published corrections change answer letters and paragraph references. Visible reading rationales point to particular narrative details, distinguish reasons from subsequent actions, and explain figurative language in context.
sources.usedFor: Repair our reading explanations that quoted an adjacent solution or initial action instead of the asked-for cause or daily action. Only our own retained passages are quoted in the revised questions.
sources.limits: Public answer/correction pages, not the complete unseen passages. The source supports the evidence-selection principle, not automatic certification of every literary inference in our banks.

sources.title: Praktis Topikal UASA (2026) Bahasa Cina Tahun 6 — published answer-page correction
sources.pages: PDF pages 1–2; printed answer page J-6; code TACPCL2606056T
sources.observed: The visible answer page links narrative motivation and emotion to paragraph evidence and explains vocabulary in the passage context.
sources.usedFor: Audit comparison for upper-primary evidence-based rationales. No separate content replacement is attributed to this source.
sources.limits: Only public correction/answer pages read; complete original questions and passages were not inspected.

sources.title: Excel PBD KSSM (2026) English Form 1 — teacher edition sample
sources.pages: Printed page 16, Unit 1 Writing, LS 4.1.1 and 4.1.2; publisher-hosted preview text read through search extraction
sources.observed: The visible model introduction and guided writing use connected information about family, home, pastimes and aspirations. Publisher landing page identifies the 2026 Form 1 sample.
sources.usedFor: Reference for coherent secondary personal contexts. Replacing primary-child minimum ages in fictional secondary notices is our editorial decision; this page supplies neither an age policy nor our notice text.
sources.limits: Inspected the search-extracted text of printed page 16. Repeat direct PDF fetch failed. Landing page https://plus.pelangibooks.com/mod/resource/view.php?forceview=1&id=21108 confirms the sample identity; no claim of full Form 1–3 coverage.

sources.title: Target PBD Bahasa Melayu Tingkatan 2 — teacher edition sample
sources.pages: Indexed preview printed EG-6, including Praktis Ekstra Tema 6, writing SP 3.7.1
sources.observed: The visible dialogue-editing activity includes corrected tense/aspect, preposition, affix and spelling choices. Its key removes redundant plural marking after a plural quantifier.
sources.usedFor: Additional audit comparison: scanned all nine BM banks' correct choices and explanations for redundant quantifier-plus-reduplication forms; no matching defect found, so no questions were rewritten for this rule.
sources.limits: Edition year not confirmed in the inspected extract. Read official search-extracted exercise and key; direct fetch exceeded the browser tool's document-size limit. This is a targeted negative check, not validation of the full 44.9 MB preview.

sources.title: Present simple — LearnEnglish A1–A2 grammar
sources.pages: Public grammar explanation: repeated actions, third-person singular forms and spelling rules
sources.observed: The reference explains habitual actions and the third-person singular changes, including common irregular forms.
sources.usedFor: Check that simplified original P1 contexts preserve the original base-form or present-simple decision and answer.
sources.limits: Language authority rather than Malaysian grade-level curriculum; no claim that A1–A2 equals Year 1.

sources.title: Before — English Grammar Today
sources.pages: Public reference section: Before with -ing; full section text returned by official-domain search extraction
sources.observed: The reference describes a non-finite clause formed with before and an -ing form.
sources.usedFor: Preserve the before + -ing grammar decision while replacing an incoherent order of actions in one Form 3 item.
sources.limits: Official search result resolves to an adjunct path but returns the Before article. Direct canonical /before fetch was unavailable. No publisher exercise copied.

sources.title: 國語辭典簡編本 — 編輯說明
sources.pages: Public editorial guide: pronunciation and neutral-tone conventions
sources.observed: The editorial guide treats neutral pronunciation in repeated words and distinguishes it from a character's marked full tone.
sources.usedFor: Make clear that the question targets the first instance of a repeated written character, retaining the original answer instead of silently deciding which syllable the learner should infer.
sources.limits: Taiwan dictionary convention is not asserted to be the Malaysian pronunciation syllabus. Used only to demonstrate a real target-position ambiguity.

sources.title: 國語辭典簡編本 — 擠
sources.pages: Public dictionary headword and definition
sources.observed: The entry describes crowding objects together within limited space.
sources.usedFor: Separate number/density of occupants from spaciousness of a location. Our original revised scenario explicitly describes increased available activity space, making the retained answer contextually justified.
sources.limits: The inference that crowding and room size are not universally logical opposites is our editorial analysis, not a claim that this entry provides an exhaustive antonym list.

sources.title: Khidmat Nasihat — kata sendi nama di dan ke
sources.pages: Public language-advice entries, including 14 August 2021, about location versus direction/destination
sources.observed: Official advice distinguishes the location function of di and the direction or destination function of ke.
sources.usedFor: Add an explicit not-yet-arrived context to the canteen sentence so that ke is uniquely licensed by the intended destination reading.
sources.limits: Read the official indexed advice text; repeat direct lookup was unavailable. Grammar evidence, not an unpublished workbook question or full syllabus audit.

sources.title: Khidmat Nasihat — objek tepat, objek sipi dan subjek ayat pasif
sources.pages: Public advice explaining promotion of the direct object to passive subject
sources.observed: The explanation states that the original direct object can become the subject of a passive sentence, illustrating why subject and actor are not universal synonyms.
sources.usedFor: Qualify the P3 explanation: in the given active sentence the subject is also the actor, while the general definition concerns what the sentence says something about.
sources.limits: Official text read in search extraction; direct lookup intermittently unavailable. We retained the original active-sentence answer.

sources.title: Mahir PBD KSSR 2022 Tahun 2 — Matematik
sources.pages: Printed page 6, SP 1.4.1–1.4.2; number-value revision notes
sources.observed: Exercises separately request place names and digit values, then decompose three-digit numbers in either representation.
sources.usedFor: Check the bank's three-digit place-value models and construct original choices which distinguish digit, place unit and positional value.
sources.limits: Only this preview topic was matched directly; current DPK topic placement is checked separately. No sample numbers or question set copied.

sources.title: Praktis Pintar KSSR 2022 Matematik Tahun 6
sources.pages: Viewer page 9 / printed page 3, whole-number objective questions
sources.observed: The sample uses seven-digit number representations, ordering by place, identifying positions in an ordered list and determining the step of a number sequence.
sources.usedFor: Compare the existing P6 depth bank's number-representation and ordering models with appropriate upper-primary demand; retain the independently correct current cases rather than add easy lower-primary replacements.
sources.limits: Only clearly readable text questions inspected; an abacus image was not interpreted from flattened text. This is not a whole P6 book review or authority for every P6 depth model.

sources.title: Mahir PBD KSSR 2022 Tahun 1 — Matematik
sources.pages: Printed RM-7 (basic shapes); printed 5–7 (quantity, number names, place and digit value), inspected in indexed publisher preview text
sources.observed: Four familiar flat-shape names are introduced. Number exercises distinguish quantity, digit, place name and digit value, with an abacus and separate place/value fields.
sources.usedFor: Retain concrete Year 1 shape vocabulary; add a familiar book-page corner cue to avoid the four-equal-sides/rhombus ambiguity. Replace adjacent-number place-value distractors with digit/place/value confusions. Transfer this arithmetic distinction to other primary levels without claiming their complete grade coverage.
sources.limits: The corner disambiguation is our mathematical repair, not copied wording. Indexed sample text was inspected; visual diagrams were not independently measured. This older preview predates DPK Edisi 3 and is not evidence of current full curriculum or UASA coverage.

sources.title: Praktis Pintar KSSR 2022 Tahun 4 — Matematik
sources.pages: Printed 1–2, number/operation notes and worked examples, inspected in indexed preview text
sources.observed: A worked place-value table uses ordinary place names through ten-thousands, separate digit values, and decomposition; arithmetic examples show positional working.
sources.usedFor: Replace the bank's unnecessary 10^k place prompts with familiar named places, preserving all numbers and answers. The same communication improvement transfers to P5.
sources.limits: This supports the named-place presentation, not a claim that every P4/P5 question or chapter was verified against this preview.

sources.title: Genius PBD KSSR (2023) Sains Tahun 1
sources.pages: Printed 1–9, scientific observing and communicating exercises; printed J1 answer discussion
sources.observed: Exercises connect senses to specific observations and communicate observations through records, tables and classification. A growth table includes labelled measurement quantities.
sources.usedFor: Review low-primary observation questions for concrete evidence and table readability. Clearly label our generated tables as simulated; carry the displayed measurement unit into numeric choices across inquiry families.
sources.limits: Synthetic-data labelling is our transparency requirement; the publisher does not prescribe this exact label. Cross-grade measurement clarity is a transferable principle, not proof of every grade's syllabus.

sources.title: PBD Plus Sains Tingkatan 1 (Edisi Guru)
sources.year: Edition year not stated on the inspected pages; publisher preview dated 2022
sources.pages: Viewer page 15 / printed page 8, density, SP 1.5.1–1.5.4
sources.observed: Density is treated as mass per volume; the worked method obtains irregular-object volume from the increase in water reading, retains units, then divides mass by volume.
sources.usedFor: Independently check density, volume and displacement formulas. Revise original choices to diagnose inversion, multiplication and using the final cylinder reading without subtracting the initial reading.
sources.limits: No publisher numbers, diagrams or exercise sets were reproduced. Related primary displacement items use the same measurement principle; this sample is not primary grade alignment evidence.

sources.title: PBD Plus Asas Sains Komputer Tingkatan 1 (Edisi Guru)
sources.year: Edition year not stated on the inspected pages; publisher preview dated 2022
sources.pages: Printed 1–3: concept notes, four-technique practice and ordered-task/pattern exercises; page 3 also available at https://online.anyflip.com/ekbvw/nhyx/files/basic-html/page8.html
sources.observed: The chapter explicitly distinguishes decomposition, pattern recognition, abstraction and generalisation. Generalisation creates a reusable model or rule. Ordered steps are also practised separately.
sources.usedFor: Replace our fourth computational-thinking category with generalisation and author new reusable-model examples. Retain existing algorithm trace questions. Update both the visible text and explanatory verification metadata consistently.
sources.limits: Algorithmic thinking is not a false concept; the repair fills a missing named KSSM technique. F2/F3 instances are prerequisite/review material subject to global progression curation, not new grade-specific claims.

sources.title: Python Language Reference — Lexical analysis, numeric and string literals
sources.pages: Sections on integer, floating-point and string literals
sources.observed: Programming literal syntax distinguishes integers, floating-point values and quoted strings; a decimal point can mark a floating-point literal even when its mathematical value is an integer.
sources.usedFor: State an explicit local pseudocode convention in data-type questions, including the 12.0 edge case, so the mathematical inclusion of integers in real numbers does not produce overlapping answer categories.
sources.limits: Technical reference, not a workbook or Malaysian curriculum source. The bank uses its own stated pseudocode convention and does not claim Python syntax or uppercase Boolean literals are Python.

sources.title: PBD Plus Matematik Tingkatan 3 (Edisi Guru)
sources.year: Edition year not stated on the inspected pages; publisher preview dated 2022
sources.pages: Viewer page 18 / printed page 11, index-law matching and worked index equations
sources.observed: Exercises distinguish base from exponent and use index laws to simplify and solve equations; worked answers expose the exponent operation.
sources.usedFor: Independently add exponents for products with the same base; supply original distractors based on multiplying or subtracting exponents instead of arbitrary adjacent integers.
sources.limits: The preview text's flattened superscripts were not used to copy or infer unseen algebra. Only the clearly identifiable same-base index principle is applied.

sources.title: PBD Plus Geografi Tingkatan 2 (Edisi Guru)
sources.year: Edition year not stated on the inspected pages; publisher preview dated 2022
sources.pages: Viewer page 7 / printed page 2, SP 1.1.1–1.1.2; viewer page 20 / printed page 15 landform-use table also inspected
sources.observed: Exercises interpret statement, linear and representative-fraction scales and express actual distances with units. The later table connects stated landform evidence to uses.
sources.usedFor: Check the map-centimetres to ground-kilometres conversion and replace arbitrary nearby options with distinct unit-conversion and missed-distance-factor errors.
sources.limits: Only the scale question family is revised from this sample; no claim of complete F1–F3 geography coverage or authentic map reproduction.

sources.title: Focus KSSM Reka Bentuk dan Teknologi Tingkatan 1 (2023)
sources.pages: Printed 35–36, project costing worked example, inspected in indexed publisher preview text
sources.observed: Project production cost separately totals material, labour and overhead; labour combines time and hourly rate; unit cost divides total cost by quantity.
sources.usedFor: Make our two-component project-cost exercises explicitly state other costs are zero. Use material-only, labour-only and missed-multiplication errors as original choices.
sources.limits: Method only; none of the sample's project, quantities or prices are copied. This F1 principle also supports F3 review cases; it does not verify all F3 RBT content.

sources.title: Reka Bentuk dan Teknologi T2 (RBT T2), ISBN 978-629-7512-13-6
sources.year: Publisher sample uploaded 2024-03-29; edition year not printed in inspected excerpt
sources.pages: Printed 1 and 3–6, inventive/non-inventive problems, function analysis and cause/effect
sources.observed: Sample explanations distinguish a component, its function and the object affected, and trace cause/effect when improving a design creates a side effect.
sources.usedFor: Review current component/function and problem-solving families; no concrete contradictory answer was identified, so no answer was changed merely to increase the change count.
sources.limits: Partial preview review, not an exhaustive F2 RBT or electrical-engineering validation.

sources.title: Surat Siaran KPM Bilangan 6 Tahun 2024 — Pelaksanaan DPK KSSR Edisi 3 Sains dan Matematik Tahap I
sources.pages: Official public notice, page 1, dated 3 May 2024
sources.observed: KPM describes reorganisation and updating of existing lower-primary mathematics/science content to support teaching and address learning gaps.
sources.usedFor: Treat pre-2024 workbook samples as concept/method evidence, not as proof that every older topic remains in the current primary core set. Existing DPK and global grade-progression curation remains authoritative for topic placement.
sources.limits: Official public document rather than commercial preview. The notice is not the full topic-by-topic DPK and does not itself certify an individual question.

sources.title: 随堂自习 道德教育 1A / Praktis Kendiri Pendidikan Moral 1A
sources.pages: printed pp15–24 and answer p39
sources.observed: Short child-life prompts practise gratitude, polite expressions and concrete conduct. Some exercises admit multiple or open responses.
sources.usedFor: Use familiar child-life decisions; make the condition for a single keyed answer explicit. Original alternatives refer to the specific action and its effect.
sources.limits: 2017 inferred from printed production footer; edition not independently established. Public sample only. No question or illustration copied; not a full grade map or independent-reading clearance. P1–P3 legacy cases remain teacher-guided.

sources.title: PBD Plus Pendidikan Moral Tingkatan 2 (EG)
sources.pages: printed pp2–5; visible unit and performance tables
sources.observed: Exercises distinguish identifying a moral source, explaining social norms, giving reasons, and expressing feelings with explanations. Group discussion and real conduct are separate tasks.
sources.usedFor: Separate proposed action, reason, possible consequence and repair. Alternatives must concern the same case instead of unrelated praise or personal reward.
sources.limits: Series year 2023; sample production footer December 2022. Publisher examples inform task design, not independent validation of every original scenario or religious assertion.

sources.title: Kuasai PBD 2024 Pendidikan Seni Visual Tingkatan 1
sources.observed: Sample tasks combine visual concepts, artwork production, material use and appreciation. Space and perspective depend on observable size, placement and tonal differences.
sources.usedFor: Specify a visual-design criterion and compare relevant technical alternatives. Distinguish an explanation of making from evidence that a pupil can make a work.
sources.limits: ISBN 9786294702349. Public excerpt; art-practice principles transfer across levels but this does not establish P1–P6 or F2–F3 syllabus coverage.

sources.title: 精通全技能综合练习 历史5下 / Latihan Mahir Integrasi Sejarah 5B
sources.observed: Exercises use distinct historical offices, national symbols and dates, with both constrained and explanatory responses. Sample content identifies the Agong election cycle and separates administrative roles.
sources.usedFor: Use historical methods and comparable concepts as alternatives, while retaining evidence qualifiers. This review does not replace factual keys solely from a catalogue.
sources.limits: 2024 is the publisher-preview upload year, not a verified edition statement. Factual keys were not changed from this sample alone; not evidence of complete syllabus coverage.

sources.title: Modul Inovasi Pendidikan Jasmani dan Pendidikan Kesihatan Tingkatan 2 / PJPK T2
sources.pages: public teacher preview e-RPH linked to workbook pp2–5
sources.observed: The visible teaching-plan sample connects gymnastics understanding to supervised activity and observation of movement performance.
sources.usedFor: Keep online concept and decision questions distinct from observed practical competence, alongside the authoritative KPM PBD guidance.
sources.limits: 2021 is public-preview upload year; edition not printed in inspected text. Read teacher-plan sample, not all workbook questions. It cannot certify exercise safety for an individual pupil.

sources.title: Music Theory example items: Grade 5 reference sheets
sources.pages: PDF pp1–4 (text layer)
sources.observed: Examples specify time-signature and note-value conventions. The reference sheet distinguishes British and American note names and explicit counting units.
sources.usedFor: State duration units precisely. Separately, our event-level audit found nine uniform clips with no audible relative-duration reference; original repairs add audible contrasts and synchronize keys.
sources.limits: ABRSM Grade 5 is not Malaysian Year 5. Used only for terminology and precision; no advanced ABRSM content transferred into primary lessons and no notation-image correctness claim.

sources.title: Panduan Pelaksanaan Pentaksiran Bilik Darjah, Edisi ke-2
sources.publisher: Kementerian Pendidikan Malaysia, Bahagian Pembangunan Kurikulum
sources.pages: printed pp46–47 (PDF pp56–57); printed pp73–74
sources.observed: Observation assesses processes and products, practical and manipulative skills, conduct and social skills. Written, oral and observed evidence can be combined for professional judgement.
sources.usedFor: Record concept-and-decision scope and require observed evidence for practical performance; do not infer actual conduct or a PBD performance level from a multiple-choice score.
sources.limits: Official guidance is publicly available full text, recorded under the common public-preview access category. Metadata alone is not an improvement to question difficulty or answer accuracy.

sources.title: KSSM Sejarah Tingkatan 1: Dokumen Standard Kurikulum dan Pentaksiran
sources.publisher: Kementerian Pendidikan Malaysia, Bahagian Pembangunan Kurikulum; hosted by Jabatan Muzium Malaysia
sources.observed: Historical thinking includes chronology, interpretation, evidence and rational explanation. Introductory content distinguishes sources and methods; case-study inquiry asks pupils to collect and evaluate evidence.
sources.usedFor: Keep primary material, later interpretation, oral evidence and corroboration distinct. Missing evidence is not proof of absence, and chronological order alone is insufficient causal evidence.
sources.limits: Curriculum and methodology reference, not a published workbook. No assertion that every generated method question is a grade-specific factual-history coverage item.

assessmentContext.title: Format Instrumen Pentaksiran UASA Tahap Dua Sekolah Rendah Tahun 2025
assessmentContext.pages: PDF pp. 4–9; linked from KPM PBS page inspected 2026-09-27
assessmentContext.observed: Primary upper-year language assessment combines comprehension and written responses. Mathematics includes constructed responses. English describes A1–A2 scope.
assessmentContext.usedFor: Keep this bank described as selected-topic practice, not a complete UASA paper or proof of writing/practical mastery.
assessmentContext.limits: Assessment-format context only; does not validate any individual answer or establish full curriculum coverage.

assessmentContext.title: Format Instrumen Pentaksiran UASA Menengah Rendah Tahun 2025
assessmentContext.pages: PDF pp. 4–8, with subject index pp. 2–3
assessmentContext.observed: Lower-secondary language formats progress in reading demands and include writing. English Form 1 describes A2 and Forms 2–3 A2/B1.
assessmentContext.usedFor: Separate grade progression and selected-skill practice from a claim to reproduce complete published examination papers.
assessmentContext.limits: Not a workbook-question source or a complete standard-by-standard alignment.

improvements: 语文：补足通知题的年龄与准备条件；区分语法和介词语境；修正引文依据与拼音指代；让低年级动作词更贴近日常生活。
数学、科学、电脑与工艺：补足形状条件、位值名称、程序字面值约定和费用假设；用常见运算与单位错误设计干扰项；标清模拟观察记录。
道德、历史、美术与音乐：按具体情境比较行动和后果，改进史料判断及制作过程选项，核对节拍、声音与文字答案。
年级与记录：与较低年级完全相同的题归入基础回顾；替换题保留旧题号及原内容用于历史记录，排除在新练习之外。
limits: 参照的是已出版练习本的公开样页及权威资料，未取得或核读所有整本书；每个来源注明实际页码、用途与限制。本站修订题保持原创。
全部序列化题目通过题号、字段、选项、答案索引和一致性检查；适用题型另做独立计算、程序、阅读证据及听觉参数核对。自然语言语义按问题家族定向审校及抽查，并非每题均经教师重新认证。
本轮来源关联包括实质文字改动和评价范围说明；来源关联题量不能等同于题干答案全部重写。可见内容变化另列统计。
部分题目仍是同类巩固变式；题量不等于独立考点数量。选择题不能代替作文、口语、实验、创作、演奏或动作评价。
历史六年级逐题审校保留其原版本范围，不自动认证本轮新身份题。尚不能宣称全套已逐项符合全部 SK/SP 或 2027 新课程。
